positions.title: Student Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-Stack Web Development Program - Underrepresented Women & Gender Expansive Adults
• Developed 12 individual and collaborative projects using agile best practices, OOP principles, RESTful API considerations, and Test-Driven Development

positions.title: Unit Lead
positions.description:
• Managed a team of six tutors and mentors supporting college students in foster care
• Collaborated with internal and external partners to develop recruitment and retention strategies for students
• Advised tutor team facilitating the second round of the Introduction to Coding program that I co-created in 2021

positions.title: Tutor - Road to Success Citywide
positions.description:
• Developed the curriculum for and co-facilitated a 12 week-long Introduction to Coding enrichment program, which had its first cohort of students in spring 2021
• Supported a caseload of 16 students in all academic subjects via virtual weekly tutoring sessions). Adapted sessions to best meet each student's individualized interests and learning styles
• Created customized lesson plans to empower each student's academic growth
• Collaborated with students, families, internal employees, and partner agency stakeholders to ensure students received effective, coordinated services
